Usage: claude [options] [command] [prompt]

Claude Code - starts an interactive session by default, use -p/--print for
non-interactive output

Arguments:
  prompt                                Your prompt

Options:
  --add-dir <directories...>            Additional directories to allow tool access to
  --agent <agent>                       Agent for the current session.
  --agents <json>                       JSON object defining custom agents
  --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions  Enable bypassing all permission checks as an option
  --allowedTools, --allowed-tools <tools...>
                                        Comma or space-separated tool names to allow
  --append-system-prompt <prompt>       Append a system prompt
  --autocompact <auto|tokens>           Auto-compact window size
  --ax-screen-reader                    Render screen-reader friendly output
  --bg, --background                    Start the session as a background agent
  --bare                                Minimal API-key or provider mode
  --betas <betas...>                    Beta headers for API key users
  --brief                               Enable SendUserMessage
  --chrome                              Enable Claude in Chrome integration
  --cloud [description|session_id|url]  Create or attach to a cloud session
  -c, --continue                        Continue the most recent conversation
  --dangerously-skip-permissions        Bypass all permission checks
  -d, --debug [filter]                  Enable debug mode
  --debug-file <path>                   Write debug logs to a file
  --disable-slash-commands              Disable all skills
  --disallowedTools, --disallowed-tools <tools...>
                                        Comma or space-separated tool names to deny
  --effort <level>                      Effort: low, medium, high, xhigh, max
  --environment <environment_id>        Create a cloud session on an environment
  --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections
                                        Move dynamic prompt sections to the first message
  --fallback-model <model>              Enable automatic fallback
  --file <specs...>                     Download file resources at startup
  --fork-session                        Create a new session ID when resuming
  --forward-subagent-text               Forward subagent stream messages
  --from-pr [value]                     Resume a session linked to a pull request
  -h, --help                            Display help
  --ide                                 Connect to an IDE
  --include-hook-events                 Include hook lifecycle events in stream-json
  --include-partial-messages            Include partial stream-json chunks
  --input-format <format>               Input format: text or stream-json
  --json-schema <schema>                JSON Schema for structured output validation
  --max-budget-usd <amount>             Maximum API dollar amount
  --mcp-config <configs...>             Load MCP servers from JSON
  --model <model>                       Claude model alias or full name
  -n, --name <name>                     Set a display name for the session
  --no-chrome                           Disable Claude in Chrome integration
  --no-session-persistence              Disable saved sessions
  --output-format <format>              Output: text, json, or stream-json
  --permission-mode <mode>              acceptEdits, auto, bypassPermissions, manual, dontAsk, plan
  --plugin-dir <path>                   Load a local plugin
  --plugin-url <url>                    Fetch a plugin archive
  -p, --print                           Print response and exit
  --prompt-suggestions [value]          Emit prompt suggestions
  --remote-control [name]               Start Remote Control
  --remote-control-session-name-prefix <prefix>
                                        Prefix Remote Control names
  --replay-user-messages                Re-emit streamed user messages
  -r, --resume [value]                  Resume by session ID
  --safe-mode                           Disable customizations while preserving auth
  --session-id <uuid>                   Use a specific session ID
  --setting-sources <sources>           Select user, project, and local settings
  --settings <file-or-json>             Load additional settings
  --strict-mcp-config                   Ignore MCP servers outside --mcp-config
  --system-prompt <prompt>              Set the system prompt
  --teleport [session]                  Resume a teleport session
  --tmux                                Create a tmux session for a worktree
  --tools <tools...>                    Select built-in tools
  --verbose                             Override verbose mode
  -v, --version                         Output the version
  -w, --worktree [name]                 Create a Git worktree

Commands:
  agents                                Manage background agents
  auth                                  Manage authentication
  auto-mode                             Inspect or reset auto mode classifier configuration
  doctor                                Check installation health
  gateway                               Run the enterprise auth/telemetry gateway
  import                                Import configuration
  install                               Install Claude Code
  mcp                                   Configure MCP servers
  plugin|plugins                        Manage Claude Code plugins
  project                               Manage project state
  setup-token                           Set up a subscription token
  ultrareview                           Run a cloud-hosted multi-agent review
  update|upgrade                        Check for updates and install
